# ChittorTech

> ChittorTech (https://chittortech.in) is a premier IT services, software engineering, and digital solutions company based in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan, India. We design, build, and deploy custom web applications, mobile apps, enterprise cloud software, and AI-driven business tools for startups, mid-market businesses, and enterprises worldwide, with special focus on clients across India, the United States, the UK, and the Middle East.

## Government & E-Governance Solutions
Official Hub: https://chittortech.in/government-egovernance-solutions
- **SP Chittorgarh Citizen Portal**: Real-time SP/ASP Jan Sunwai (जन सुनवाई) officer availability status, direct police station telephone directory, FIR guidance, and 24/7 public grievance helpline.
- **Nagar Parishad Civic Grievance Redressal System**: Automated 2-step civic complaint management across 60+ wards with geotagged photo evidence, sanitary inspector assignment, ward heatmaps, and citizen WhatsApp notifications (65% faster redressal).
- **Panch Gaurav Digital Pride Archive**: Showcasing the 5 Pillars of Chittorgarh district pride (monuments, freedom struggle, agriculture, industrial pride, folk culture) with 10,000+ monthly visitors.
- **Compliance Standards**: Compliant with General Financial Rules (GFR), GIGW 3.0 accessibility, WCAG 2.1 AA, MeitY-empaneled Indian cloud hosting, 100% source code handover, and SLA-backed AMC support.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Custom Web Development**: High-performance, SEO-optimized web applications built with Next.js, React, Node.js, and modern full-stack architectures.
- **Mobile Application Development**: Native and cross-platform iOS and Android apps using Flutter and React Native.
- **Enterprise Software & ERP**: Scalable cloud ERPs, CRM platforms, accounting software, and workflow automation.
- **Specialized Industry Solutions**:
  - Cloud Property Management Systems (PMS) & Hotel Management Software
  - Temple Management Systems & Religious Trust Administrative ERPs
  - Educational Institute & School Management Portals
  - E-commerce & Multi-vendor Marketplace Platforms
- **AI & Intelligent Automation**: Enterprise AI support chatbots, conversational knowledge bases, automated customer support workflows, and predictive analytics.
- **Enterprise Cloud & Email Infrastructure**:
  - Email Deliverability Engineering & Inbox Placement (https://chittortech.in/email-deliverability-services)
  - DMARC, DKIM & SPF Compliance Setup (https://chittortech.in/dmarc-dkim-spf-setup)
  - BIMI & Verified Email Branding (https://chittortech.in/business-email-branding-bimi)
  - Enterprise DNS & Cloudflare Management (https://chittortech.in/dns-cloudflare-management)
  - Email Blacklist Removal & Reputation Recovery (https://chittortech.in/email-blacklist-removal)
  - Cloud Hosting & Production Deployment (https://chittortech.in/cloud-hosting-deployment)
- **Google Play Store Publishing & Closed Testing Compliance**: End-to-end Google Play Console publishing, compliance with the official Google 12-Tester Rule (14 continuous days), target SDK 34+/35 audit, and production release access (https://chittortech.in/google-play-publishing). Milestone: 50+ apps published globally within 6 months with 100% first-attempt approval.
- **UI/UX Engineering**: User-centric product design, design systems, modern responsive interfaces, and interactive dashboards.

## Google Play Publishing Packages & Pricing
- **Publish on Your Account**: ₹10,299 INR / $129 USD (one-time) — Full Play Console audit, 12 opted-in verified testers for 14 continuous days, privacy policy generation, target SDK compliance, and production release management.
- **Publish on ChittorTech Account**: ₹25,999 INR / $299 USD (one-time) — Client needs NO developer console account; published & maintained under ChittorTech's verified Organization Console with enterprise signing keys and lifetime hosting.
- **Full Account Setup & Launch**: ₹29,499 INR / $339 USD (one-time) — End-to-end setup and verification of client's own Google Play Developer Console (Personal or Organization with D-U-N-S guidance), 12-tester closed testing management, and live production launch.
- **Client Privacy & NDA Commitment**: All client source codes, apps, and business details are protected under strict Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDA) and never publicly disclosed without written consent.
- **Showcased Reference Apps**: künh (tech.kunh.app, Turkey/Global client — production access granted), Reward Club (com.rewardclub.app — closed testing), Visit Chittorgarh (com.kushsharma.visitchittorgarh — live client tourism app), Mewari Achaar (com.mewari.achaar — live e-commerce app).
- **Free 15-Minute Audit**: Complimentary preliminary APK/AAB review for target SDK and Play Store policy compliance.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js, React.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, HTML5/CSS3, GSAP.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express, Python, Django, REST APIs, GraphQL.
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Firebase Firestore, Redis.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Vercel, Firebase Hosting, Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD.
- **Mobile**: Flutter, React Native, iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin).
